To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

sea foam is a lossy dielectric material, the skin depth of foam is less than 10 cm at microwave frequencies, and the foam skin depth depends on the frequency of the incident radiation, the thickness of the foam layer, and its void fraction profile.
the microwave skin depth of sea foam is less than that of seawater, and that foam emissivity is sensitive to the vertical structure of foam layers. [2]

the foam skin depth at microwave frequencies is much less than the foam layer thickness, that the skin depth decreases with increasing frequency, that the skin depths of foam layers of thicknesses from 2 cm to 5 cm are in the range of 0.2 to 0.5 cm, that the skin thicknesses are much smaller than those of seawater layers, and that the skin depths vary with the foam layer thickness and void fraction profile.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model for sea foam emissivity in the microwave range.
the development of a foam emissivity modeling approach that is based on the skin depth of foam layers and the foam emissivity.

the following: (1) the dielectric constant of seawater and sea foam; (2) the skin depth of vertically layered foam and seawater; (3) the foam emissivity model; and (4) the passive remote sensing of sea foam.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the foam skin depth is a function of the foam thickness, void fraction profile, and frequency.
the skin depth of a foam layer is a function of foam layer thickness, frequency, and foam void fraction profile. [2]
the foam skin depth depends on frequency, foam layer thickness, foam properties, and foam layer shape and structure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sea foam is a complex and dynamic medium that is difficult to characterize and model, but the foam emissivity can be modeled by the foam layer skin depth.
the foam emissivity is determined by the foam skin depth.
sea foam emissivity is mainly a function of foam thickness, foam void fraction profile, and frequency.
The main takeaway from our work is that

foam skin depth varies significantly with frequency and foam thickness, and the skin depth can be as small as the foam thickness, which means that the entire thickness of the foam is involved in the absorption of microwave radiation.
the foam emissivity is a complex function of the foam layer thickness and the void fraction profile.
foam emissivity is a function of foam skin depth, which depends on foam thickness and frequency.
